title: My best year at school

before.predict: Look at the title and the picture. What is Aziz doing this year?

text.title: This year I am trying everything!
paragraphs: Hello! My name is Aziz and I am twelve. This **year** is my best school year. I am doing three new things!

First, I am in the **chess** **club**. We meet on Mondays. I am **learning** new moves and I **practise** every evening with my grandfather. He always wins, but I am getting better! Our club has twelve students and one old chess board.

Second, I am playing football. Our **team** is small but fast. We **practise** on Wednesdays after school. Our teacher, Mr Karimov, is a very good coach. Last Saturday we played against School 22 and we won two goals to one!
Third, I am **learning** English with my friend Shoxrux. We watch short films and we write new words in a little book. We have 200 words now! My favourite new word this month is “amazing”.
What are you doing this **year**? Tell me in the comments!
